te: San Agustin Church in Manila is officially completed; it is the oldest church still standing in the Philippines.
dz: 马尼拉的圣阿古斯丁教堂正式完工;它是菲律宾现存最古老的教堂.
de: San Agustin Church in Manila is officially completed; it is the oldest church still standing in the Philippines.

t: 英格兰布里斯托尔海峡和塞弗恩埃斯图里海岸一带估计有200平方英里(51,800公顷)被大洪水所…
te: An estimated 200 square miles (51,800 ha) along the coasts of the Bristol Channel and Severn Estuary in England are des…
dz: 英格兰布里斯托尔海峡和塞弗恩埃斯图里海岸一带估计有200平方英里(51,800公顷)被大洪水所摧毁,估计造成2000人死亡.
de: An estimated 200 square miles (51,800 ha) along the coasts of the Bristol Channel and Severn Estuary in England are destroyed by massive flooding, resulting in an estimated 2,000 deaths.

te: L'Orfeo by Claudio Monteverdi, one of the first works recognized as an opera, receives its première performance.
dz: L'Orfeo by Claudio Monteverdi, 第一部被公认为是一出歌剧的作品之一,获得其预科表演.
de: L'Orfeo by Claudio Monteverdi, one of the first works recognized as an opera, receives its première performance.

de: Susenyos I defeats the combined armies of Yaqob and Abuna Petros II at the Battle of Gol in Gojjam, making him Emperor of Ethiopia.

t: 荷兰分舰队在直布罗陀摧毁锚地西班牙分舰队.
te: The Dutch fleet destroys the anchored Spanish fleet at Gibraltar.
dz: 80年战争:荷兰分舰队在直布罗陀摧毁锚地西班牙分舰队.
de: Eighty Years' War: The Dutch fleet destroys the anchored Spanish fleet at Gibraltar.

t: 弗吉尼亚公司殖民者在亨利角登陆.
te: The Virginia Company colonists make landfall at Cape Henry.
dz: 弗吉尼亚公司殖民者在亨利角登陆.
de: The Virginia Company colonists make landfall at Cape Henry.

t: 英国殖民者建立了"詹姆斯堡",该地会成为弗吉尼亚州的詹姆斯敦,是美洲最早的永久英语居民点.
te: English colonists establish "James Fort", which would become Jamestown, Virginia, the earliest permanent English settle…
dz: 英国殖民者建立了"詹姆斯堡",该地会成为弗吉尼亚州的詹姆斯敦,是美洲最早的永久英语居民点.
de: English colonists establish "James Fort", which would become Jamestown, Virginia, the earliest permanent English settlement in the Americas.

t: 詹姆斯敦(英语:Jamestown)是北美第一个永久的英国殖民地,已成立.
te: Jamestown, the first permanent English colony in North America, is founded.
dz: 詹姆斯敦(英语:Jamestown)是北美第一个永久的英国殖民地,已成立.
de: Jamestown, the first permanent English colony in North America, is founded.

t: 弗吉尼亚殖民者完成詹姆斯要塞的建造,以防御西班牙和美洲原住民的攻击.
te: Virginia colonists finish building James's Fort, to defend against Spanish and Native American attacks.
dz: 弗吉尼亚殖民者完成詹姆斯要塞的建造,以防御西班牙和美洲原住民的攻击.
de: Virginia colonists finish building James's Fort, to defend against Spanish and Native American attacks.

de: Edward Maria Wingfield is ousted as first president of the governing council of the Colony of Virginia; he is replaced by John Ratcliffe.

dz: 据约翰·史密斯(John Smith)所言,波沃坦领袖瓦洪森纳科夫之女宝嘉康蒂(Pocahontes)在部落领袖试图处死他后,成功地为自己的生命求情.
de: According to John Smith, Pocahontas, daughter of Powhatan leader Wahunsenacawh, successfully pleads for his life after tribal leaders attempt to execute him.
